script_text: Full Moon Ritual has no birth sign—yet beyond the veil, Aries, ruled by Mars, activates elemental fire through tonight’s Moon. The September 26 Full Moon is astronomical, not a separate horoscope. In the ritual chart, Aries occupies the 1st House, Virgo the 7th, and their opposition exposes relationship dynamics. Every rising sign meets this 1st–7th reckoning of self and partnership. Aries rising can receive a love offer after stating needs; Cancer or Capricorn rising gets a 10th-house Sun trine to the 1st-house Moon, favoring promotion or client income; Taurus rising faces shared-money strain under the 8th–2nd opposition. North Node names your growth direction; natal Chiron exposes the fear driving this pattern. Karmically, release control, not love; forgiveness never excuses inconsistency. Do the ritual after sunset; delay impulsive relationship moves or speculative spending until the Moon separates from opposition. Comment your rising sign.
